summary: Another project idea for https://credcon.org, we need media remix machine, have prior art examples to look at in @zeega and @mozilla Popcorn. I envision rebuilding this using CSS Grid and a z index to stack media. Just have it export an HTML file, no hosting.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Another project idea for https://credcon.org, we need media remix machine, have prior art examples to look at in @zeega and @mozilla Popcorn.

I envision rebuilding this using CSS Grid and a z index to stack media. Just have it export an HTML file, no hosting.
